scene:
Three zones read left to right, separated by generous space.

LEFT ZONE (narrow), a target paired with its guardrail, stacked vertically: at the top a small bar chart with a rising teal arrow, labelled GROWTH TARGET 25%; below it, joined to it by a short navy chain, an ochre shield with a plain check mark inside it, labelled GUARDRAIL: RETENTION ≥ 90%.

MIDDLE ZONE (widest), one proposal splitting into four bets. At the top centre a small office building with a closing padlock on its door, labelled CLOSE SUPPORT SITE, and beside it a single stack of plain coins with no symbols, labelled SAVES €600K A YEAR. From the building four arrows fan downward to four objects in a row: (1) a person in a suit holding a briefcase, labelled EXECUTIVE +€300K; (2) a bank vault, labelled FUND +€4M; (3) exactly fourteen small standing figures in two rows of seven (count them: 7 + 7 = 14), the first eleven drawn faded in grey and the last three drawn solid teal, labelled 11 OF 14 JOBS LOST; (4) a stack of blank contract papers with only wavy grey lines for text (no letters or words on them), a calendar with no numbers, and a small ochre warning triangle, labelled 30 RENEWALS AT RISK.

RIGHT ZONE, two horizontal timelines stacked. Upper timeline, short and thin, labelled NINE-MONTH CLOSURE, with a large ochre stamp across it labelled REJECTED. Lower timeline, longer and bold teal, labelled STAGED OVER 12 MONTHS, with two milestones: the first marker carries a group of exactly six small figures walking out, labelled 6 LEAVE AT MONTH 6; the second marker, at the end, carries a group of exactly five small figures walking out, labelled 5 LEAVE AT MONTH 12. Just before each milestone stands a small identical gate icon with a pause symbol; one label placed between the two gates reads PAUSE IF RENEWALS OR WAITING SLIP. Below the lower timeline, three standing figures each holding a plain round ochre coin with no symbol or letter on it, labelled SPECIALISTS PAID TO STAY.

TEXT: draw exactly these labels, each once and nothing else: GROWTH TARGET 25%, GUARDRAIL: RETENTION ≥ 90%, CLOSE SUPPORT SITE, SAVES €600K A YEAR, EXECUTIVE +€300K, FUND +€4M, 11 OF 14 JOBS LOST, 30 RENEWALS AT RISK, NINE-MONTH CLOSURE, REJECTED, STAGED OVER 12 MONTHS, 6 LEAVE AT MONTH 6, 5 LEAVE AT MONTH 12, PAUSE IF RENEWALS OR WAITING SLIP, SPECIALISTS PAID TO STAY. No other numbers, month markers or tick labels on the timelines. Any other text is a defect. No currency symbols anywhere except in the labels.
alt: A proposal to close a second support site that saves €600,000 a year splits into four bets: the executive gains €300,000, the fund €4 million, eleven of fourteen people lose their jobs and thirty customer renewals are at risk; a growth target of 25% is paired with a retention guardrail of at least 90%; the rejected nine-month closure is set against the chosen staged closure over twelve months, with six people leaving at month six, five at month twelve, specialists paid to stay and gates that pause if renewals or waiting times slip.
caption: One proposal, four different bets, and a staged decision that protects the customers without pretending the cost to employees has gone.
